verdict.rationale: Finix documents APIs to build custom onboarding, payout, and dispute experiences under the platform's own brand (finix-docs-9, finix-docs-10, finix-docs-12, finix-docs-17) plus dashboard-based reporting (finix-docs-24), suggesting sellers' financial data/actions can be surfaced via API in a host product. However, there is no explicit mention of pre-built white-label UI components/widgets (e.g., embeddable balance or transaction-history widgets) — only APIs and Finix's own hosted Dashboard/forms are described. missing for 10: explicit embeddable/white-label UI component library for balances/transaction history, evidence of branding customization on hosted components, independent confirmation of embedding experience.
